2607.10474.title: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Physics: Post-training LLMs with Continuous Rewards
2607.10474.paper_summary: Partial differential equations (PDEs) are foundational to modeling in science and engineering, but constructing reliable numerical solvers remains labor-intensive, demanding expert knowledge of discretization schemes, stability conditions, and boundary treatments. Recent work has begun to frame PDE solving as a code-generation task for large language models (LLMs), yet existing approaches operate primarily at inference time: relying on prompting, debugging, self-refinement, and test-time scaling rather than adapting the model itself. In parallel, reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has emerged as a post-training paradigm for code and math reasoning, but its verifiers are typically binary: a compiler runs, or a test passes. Such signals discard the graded structure of scientific correctness, where two solvers may both execute and yet differ in solution accuracy by orders of magnitude. In this work, we introduce RLVP: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Physics, an RL post-training framework for multi-PDE solver code generation. RLVP addresses this verifiability gap with a hybrid verifier: hard program-validity checks ensure executability, while continuous physics rewards score function-space accuracy and PDE-residual consistency. A single policy is post-trained across diverse PDE families spanning hyperbolic, parabolic, elliptic, and incompressible-flow systems. RLVP improves over both pre-trained and supervised-only baselines on PDE benchmarks, and shows zero-shot improvement transfer to held-out PDEs. We show that a smaller LLM post-trained with RLVP can outperform prompting a frontier model on in-distribution PDE solver generation. The trained policy shows evidence of compositionality in numerical motifs: it recombines stencils, time-stepping schemes, and boundary-handling primitives learned from the PDEs used in training into generated solvers for unseen PDE problems.
2607.10474.paper_summary_zh: 偏微分方程（PDE）是科學和工程建模的基礎，但構建可靠的數值求解器仍然需要大量的勞動，並且需要對離散化方案、穩定性條件和邊界處理有專業知識。最近的研究開始將PDE求解框架化為大型語言模型（LLMs）的代碼生成任務，但現有的方法主要在推理階段運作：依賴於提示、調試、自我改進和測試時縮放，而不是適應模型本身。與此同時，使用可驗證獎勵的強化學習已經成為代碼和數學推理的後訓練範式，但其驗證者通常是二元的：編譯器運行，或者測試通過。這些信號忽略了科學正確性的分級結構，其中兩個求解器可能都能執行，但在解的準確性上卻可能相差幾個量級。在這項工作中，我們介紹了RLVP：可驗證物理的強化學習，這是一個用於多PDE求解器代碼生成的RL後訓練框架。RLVP通過混合驗證器解決了這一可驗證性差距：嚴格的程序有效性檢查確保可執行性，而連續的物理獎勵則評分函數空間的準確性和PDE殘差的一致性。單一策略在跨越雙曲、拋物、橢圓和不可壓流系統的多樣PDE家族中進行後訓練。RLVP在PDE基準測試中超越了預訓練和僅監督的基線，並顯示出對保留PDE的零樣本改進轉移。我們展示了一個較小的LLM經過RLVP後訓練可以在分佈內的PDE求解器生成上超越提示前沿模型。訓練後的策略顯示出數值主題的組合性證據：它將從訓練中使用的PDE學到的模板、時間步進方案和邊界處理原語重新組合成生成的未見PDE問題的求解器。
